node.name: Re-serialize as X12 and send by SFTP
node.logic: If all three values exist, set EDI.*ForSend context properties and send through EdiSend pipeline to sftp://${SD_SFTP_HOST_BBVA}/${SD_SFTP_FOLDER_BBVA}/835/835_<MessageID>.edi. Else the message is dropped without a log. Orchestration state is Unenlisted in the Cloud9.EDI binding (Started in the PDS binding).
